{{Top|leg}}
The '''All-World Games''' was a yearly contest of speed, endurance and skill held on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Senali]]. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Leed]], the [[Rutanian]] ward of the [[Senali Royal Family]], consistently won the competition since he was thirteen years old. In [[45 BBY/Legends|45 BBY]], Leed shared the top spot with his friend [[Drenna]].<ref name="TSP">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Shattered Peace]]''</ref>
